The correction lesson says: Correct label 【挪用资金】 (not 挪用公款) when the misappropriated funds are private/enterprise/organization funds, not state public funds. Here the organization is a religious committee, not a state entity. So it's private funds. So label should be 挪用资金.

Second part: "挪用特定款物" - misusing disaster relief donations. This is also misappropriation of specific funds, likely "挪用资金". Could also be "挪用特定款物"? But the standard criminal law term is "挪用资金" (misappropriation of funds). The correction lesson says use 挪用资金 for private funds. In Chinese criminal law, "职务侵占" is a specific crime for public officials misappropriating public funds. But for non-public officials, it's "挪用资金". The correction says to use 挪用资金 not 挪用公款.
